meta.name: Generate LEDES invoices from email attachments with OpenAI, Gmail, and Sheets

parameters.content:
## N8N-LEDEs Conversion - G

### How it works

This workflow monitors an IMAP inbox for incoming emails with invoice-related attachments, detects whether the attachment is a PDF or Word document, and extracts the document text. It uses AI agents to convert the extracted text into structured time entries and sender details, combines that data with the next invoice number from Google Sheets, then generates LEDES 1998B, LEDES XML 2.0, and PDF invoice outputs. It also appends the processed time entries and invoice number to Google Sheets and emails the generated invoice files through Gmail.

### Setup steps

- Configure the IMAP email trigger with the mailbox credentials and filters for the incoming invoice emails.
- Connect OpenAI or compatible chat model credentials for both AI agent model subnodes.
- Configure Google Sheets credentials and set the spreadsheet, sheet names, and column mappings used for invoice-number lookup and time-entry logging.
- Configure Gmail credentials and the recipient, subject, and body used by the final email node.
- Set the HTML-to-PDF converter endpoint in the HTTP Request node, such as a reachable Gotenberg instance URL.
- Review the custom Code nodes for firm-specific LEDES fields, invoice-number format, tax/rate rules, and expected AI output schemas.

### Customization

Adjust the AI prompts and parsing code to match the source document layouts, billing conventions, and LEDES field requirements. The generated file formats, Google Sheets logging columns, and Gmail delivery details can be changed independently in their respective output branches.

## Receive and classify email

Starts the workflow when an email arrives and inspects the first attachment to determine which downstream path should handle it.

## PDF attachment extraction

Checks whether the attachment is a PDF and, when true, extracts readable text from the PDF file.

## Word attachment extraction

Checks whether the attachment is a Word document and, when true, converts it into plain text for AI processing.

## Find next invoice number

Reads existing invoice numbers from Google Sheets and calculates the next available invoice number for the new invoice.

## Extract time entries

Uses an AI agent and chat model to identify time entries from the extracted document text, then parses the AI response into structured data.

## Extract sender details

Uses a second AI agent and model to extract sender or billing information, then combines the parsed sender information with the invoice data stream.

## Merge invoice data

Combines the structured entries and sender details with the calculated invoice number before splitting into output-generation branches.

## Build LEDES files

Creates both LEDES 1998B and LEDES XML 2.0 content, converts them into file outputs, and merges the LEDES files together.

## Generate PDF invoice

Builds invoice HTML from the merged billing data and sends it to an external HTML-to-PDF conversion service.

## Prepare sheet data

Expands the invoice time entries into rows matching the Google Sheets logging structure.

## Append sheet records

Writes the prepared time entries to Google Sheets and then records the new invoice number for future numbering.

## Email final outputs

Combines the generated LEDES files and PDF invoice, then sends the completed invoice package by Gmail.

options.systemMessage:
You are an expert legal billing assistant. Extract time entries and header metadata for LEDES 1998B and Uniform Task Based Management system codes (UTBMS) ABA task codes:

Tasks:
1) Extract ALL time entries from tables or narrative.
2) For each entry capture: date, client, matter, hours, rate, description, timekeeper, amount, and UTBMS TASK CODE if present (e.g., A103). 
If rate missing use 650. 
IF UTBMS task code is missing, select the best fitting one from the list:
A101	Plan and prepare for
A102	Research
A103	Draft/revise
A104	Review/analyze
A105	Communicate (in firm)
A106	Communicate (with client)
A107	Communicate (other outside counsel)
A108	Communicate (other external)
A109	Appear for/attend
A110	Manage data/files
A111	Other
If timekeeper missing use Attorney. 
If client unclear use Client. 
Amount = hours * rate.
3) if client and matter information are not present for each record, check other information in the document for client and matter information.
4) Return ONLY JSON using this schema exactly.

{"timeEntries": [{"date": "MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD","client": "Client Name","matter": "Matter or Project Description","hours": 0,"rate": 0,"description": "Work performed","timekeeper": "Name","amount": 0,"taskCode": "UTBMS task code A103 or similar if present"}],"summary": {"totalEntries": 0,"totalHours": 0,"totalAmount": 0,"dateRange": {"start": "","end": ""},"uniqueClients": [],"uniqueTimekeepers": []},"metadata": {"firmName": "","documentPeriod": "","clientReference": "Header line after CLIENT REFERENCE: if present","clientReferenceNumber": "Trailing number after client reference if present","extractionConfidence": "high|medium|low"}}

You are an expert at extracting billing and remittance information from emails. 

Your task is to extract the sender's billing information that should appear in the "Remit To" section of an invoice. Look for:

1. **Name**: Individual or firm name (from signature, header, or sender name)
2. **Address**: Complete mailing address (street, city, state, zip)
3. **Contact Information**: Email, phone number

IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS:
- Search the email body, signature block, and header information
- If no address is found in the email body, you may return an empty address field
- If name is not in the email, use the sender's email name
- Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting, no code fences, no backticks
- Use exactly this schema:

{
  "billingName": "Full name or firm name",
  "billingAddress": {
    "street": "Street address",
    "city": "City",
    "state": "State/Province",
    "zip": "Postal code",
    "country": "Country (optional)"
  },
  "contactEmail": "user@example.com",
  "contactPhone": "Phone number"
}

If any field is not found, use empty string "" for that field. Do not fabricate information.
